overview: The Neimoidian corporate directorate that governed Trade Federation commerce, blockades, and private droid armies from Lucrehulk command ships.
history: Trade Federation Directorate governed galactic affairs during the Trade Federation. Detailed chronicles, succession rules, and institutional structure will be expanded in a future update.
significance: Trade Federation Directorate shaped the political identity of its era and remains a reference point when historians compare later governments across the Star Wars timeline.
notableEvents: Trade Federation Directorate established as a governing authority in galactic records
